outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of sFlt-1/PlGF ratio for pre-eclampsia
cohort: 170 pregnant women with at least one sign/symptom of suspected/diagnosed pre-eclampsia
finding: The sFlt-1/PlGF ratio, in conjunction with standard diagnostic criteria, can be used to rule out pre-eclampsia, identify high-risk patients, and predict adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Higher sFlt-1/PlGF ratios were associated with a higher number of caesarean deliveries.
gest_age: Shorter gestational age at birth was associated with higher sFlt-1/PlGF ratios.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight was associated with higher sFlt-1/PlGF ratios.
